title: Separate modeling, identification, estimation and refutation
sourceSection: Estimating Causal Effects: four-step workflow and identification strategies
scope: Estimating causal effects using data and domain knowledge
summary: State assumptions and a causal representation before identifying the effect. Choose an estimator compatible with identification, then study robustness to assumptions. This order avoids confusing an estimated association with an identified causal effect.
interpretation: ResearchPi blocks supported conclusions when required elements are missing and distinguishes non-identifiability from insufficient information. Field validation does not prove assumptions.
limitations: Passing refutation tests does not prove all assumptions. The MVP does not run DoWhy estimators or identify effects automatically.
